title: Escríbame a mi número personal: la nota de voz que no era para el grupo (Serie Sala de Juntas, video 14)

ia.dice: Asesores inmobiliarios: así me quedo con los leads de la inmobiliaria.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Daytime, a narrow office hallway of a real estate agency next to the restrooms, a fire extinguisher on the wall. Karla, a Mexican real estate agent in her late twenties with a very tight high ponytail, huge fake eyelashes, a leopard print blouse and long pink nails, hides in the hallway, looks left and right, then leans toward the camera with a sly smile and says in Mexican Spanish, whispering, like a mockumentary confession: "Asesores inmobiliarios: así me quedo con los leads de la inmobiliaria." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only her voice in Spanish, muffled office ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: Señora, escríbame a mi número personal, ¿sí? Yo le consigo uno igualito… y no le comente a nadie.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Daytime, a narrow office hallway of a real estate agency next to the restrooms. Karla, a Mexican real estate agent in her late twenties with a very tight high ponytail, huge fake eyelashes, a leopard print blouse and long pink nails, holds her phone close to her mouth recording a WhatsApp voice note, covering it with her other hand and says in Mexican Spanish, whispering fast, conspiratorial: "Señora, escríbame a mi número personal, ¿sí? Yo le consigo uno igualito… y no le comente a nadie." Close-up, static camera. Audio: only her voice in Spanish. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: ¿Qué? No, no, no… ¿lo mandé al grupo de la inmobiliaria?

No, no, no… ¿lo mandé al grupo de la inmobiliaria?" Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only her voice in Spanish, a phone notification sound. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

scenes.text: Esta vez la cacharon por error. Pero casi siempre pasa en el WhatsApp personal del asesor, y en tu inmobiliaria nadie se entera.
Lead Master se conecta al WhatsApp y a las llamadas de tus asesores y vendedores, y en automático te dice qué pasó con cada lead. Todos los días te llega el reporte, sin que nadie llene nada.
